After going through the paragraph No. 8 of such affidavit dated 02.02.2026 filed on behalf of the respondent No. 6, when we made a query to the learned senior counsel appearing for the NHAI that why such amount has not been deposited with the State authorities, even though it has been approved, the learned counsel submits that there is a Bhoomi Rashi Portal and once the decision is taken for approving the amount it is transferred to such portal and there would be no difficulty on the part of the State authorities to disburse such amount to the concerned land owners.

4. Since there is some kind of differences in the submissions which have been made by the learned counsel for the NHAI as well as the learned counsel for the State that what is the actual amount deposited with the State authorities for disbursal, let an affidavit be filed in that respect by the NHAI authorities and the learned counsel for the State has assured that if the amount is received from the NHAI authorities to the said portal, i.e., Bhoomi Rashi Portal, necessary steps shall be taken immediately for disbursal of the amount in favour of the land owners whose lands have been acquired.
5.

Since in various cases complaints have been made that there is low percentage of the disbursal of the compensation Patna High Court CWJC No.3079 of 2022(19) dt.05-02-2026 amount in favour of the land owners, in every case where such statement is made, the concerned authorities shall file an affidavit indicating therein the reason for the delayed disbursal of the amount in favour of the land owners.

"...7.

Details regarding progress of the acquisition process of the land with respect of those 39 villages are given in paragraphs herein below.

11.
That with regard to 04 Revenue villages namely Maheshdih, Dumariya, Kiratpur and Madhuri; Notification regarding acquisition of land u/s 3A of the NHAI Act 1956 is in progress.
The draft 3 A notification for above mentioned 4 revenue villages has been Patna High Court CWJC No.3079 of 2022(19) dt.05-02-2026 uploaded in Bhumi Rashi Portal.
The reason for delay in those 04 villages isdue to lack coordinated entries in Chakbandi Khatiyan vis a vis Cadastral Khatiyan/Revisional Khatiyan.
The issue has now been resolved by the directives issued under letter dated 16.07.2025 issued by the Additional Chief Secretary, Revenue and land Reforms Department..."

7. After going through the above counter affidavit filed by the respondent No. 6, we find as has been mentioned in paragraph No. 9 that 1582 awards have been prepared and notices were sent to the beneficiaries to submit their relevant documents.
It needs to be expedited so that the beneficiaries get the awards at the earliest.

So far as paragraph No. 10 is concerned, since compensation amount has been estimated u/s 3G of the NHAI Act 1956 and after calculation it has been sent to the NHAI for approval since 22.12.2025, the learned counsel for the NHAI shall obtain instruction regarding the approval of such amount and to be made available on the Bhoomi Rashi Portal for its disbursal.
8. The state authorities shall ensure the physical handing over of the land to the NHAI authorities so that there would be real progress of the work.
